name: Prepare a CAB packet
intent: One artifact a CAB chair can open: the change, its conflicts, approvals outstanding, implementation plan, and who speaks.

change_numbers.description: Change numbers to prepare; omit when using agenda_date

agenda_date.description: CAB agenda date to select changes

procedure: Input: CAB agenda date or a list of change numbers.
List open approvals and change tasks not Closed.
Return a packet object suitable for generative UI or a slide export. Do not invent attendance.

prompts: Build the CAB packet for Thursday's agenda.
What do we need for CAB on CHG0031842?
